snapshot_scope: Saved v15 metadata; exact local frontend sources matched captured v13 pins. v14/v15 supplied revision changes do not replace this frontend. No fresh remote verification.
calculation_limits: Nominal gap excess compares frame-start spacing with ideal 20 ms; it is not a measured queue-age trajectory or pure scheduler-wait counter.
Wall minus threadCPU combines scheduler/GIL/native blocking and cannot attribute a cause alone.
Failed and follow-up snapshots retain one failure generation; cumulative count3 is not proof all failures arose during scheduling tests.
First/source read maxima include startup/blocking time; similar >800 ms in the healthy capture disproves using that field alone as the overflow cause.
Saved latency/ACK fields may belong to previous rounds and are not tied to the failing capture.
hot_path_findings: Exactly one shared gate; full automatic PCM/endpoint/queue run in child. No per-frame parent IPC in automatic mode.
Parent AUTO_POLL period0.05s; child snapshots/white-list validation/JSON share its process with the consumer. Status detach was already optimized in v13.
Combined uses reused quantization/window/complex buffers and ping-pong CPU IO bindings; no duplicate neural-model pass, model reload, SHA hashing or warmup per frame.
SpeechEndpoint.feed still copies each already-aligned immutable640B input through pending bytearray before float conversion.
Inherited FftGtcrnDenoiser._consume concatenates even a single independent hop array on75percent of320-sample calls.
EnergyVad.accept copies pending+frame even though production supplies exact320-sample frames; defensive float validation is repeated at API boundaries.
Endpoint diagnostics lock/counters occur after endpoint timer sampling. Existing evidence does not establish them as the dominant cost.

Silent listening is intentionally eligible for background memory work through GuiBoardBusiness.capture_idle. If metadata transport is later measured material, unchanged status can suppress only redundant serialization with bounded heartbeat and immediate onset/error/READY/cancel publication. Current20Hz frequency must not be blindly reduced.
not_recommended: No energy-based skipping of GTCRN/Silero frames: recurrent model state and speech decisions would change.
No frame drops, larger capture queue, changed VAD/identity thresholds, lowered renderer target or global priority/affinity mutation.
No claim that combined can be re-enabled for another gain: it is already selected. Prior public ARM mean15.863 to15.551ms is onlyabout2percent and not complete-GUI longrun evidence.
No claim that stats/IPC removal alone solves the CPU budget.
next_validation: First quantify consumer schedstat/context-switch/migration and full-frame subphase timing during an otherwise unchanged restore window; no new test was run here. Compare CPU cost versus offCPU time, source bursts and queue-age trend. Any allocation-only candidate must keep exact model-call sequence, numerical PCM/VAD/endpoint and existing8-frame ownership/cancel/ACK contracts, then pass same public paced stream with full GUI/camera before adoption.
